all.description: true = read every waiting letter, not just the oldest

keep.description: true = keep the letters you read in mailbox/archive/ (default: removed). A file name (from your workspace; its folder must exist) = append one JSON line per letter to that file ("kept": "received", letter, from, to, status, title, what, outputs, not_done, decide, sent_at, in_reply_to; no absolute paths); a letter leaves the mailbox only after its line is written
